items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Interviewer asks: 'And you took up Clarenette, how much did you practice in the beginning when you first started?'

ctx.x: It would be better for me, I think. Yeah. Of course, now that I got used to this one, I guess the problem would be about the same.
And you took up Clarenette, how much did you practice in the beginning when you first started?

Well, I practiced every chance that I got. And I was waking, I was waking at the daytime. I'd go to work at 7 o'clock in the morning and knock off at 5.30 in the evening. And I'd get up in the morning before I'd go to work and wake people in the neighborhood.
